entities.name: Abū ʿAmr al-Dānī
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abū ʿAmr al-Dānī (981–1053), called Ibn al-Ṣayrafī, was a Mālikī lawyer, muḥaddith (traditionist) and Qurʾānic muqriʾ (reciter) from al-Andalus. He founded his own school of Qurʾān recitation.
